prompt: React vs Vue: which should I learn first?

plan.title: React vs Vue: Which Should You Learn First?
plan.description: A blunt comparison of React and Vue for beginners choosing a first JavaScript framework. Learn what each offers and which to pick for your goal.

beats.narration: Stop agonizing. React or Vue, you will not pick wrong. Both teach the same core ideas: components, state, and building screens from small reusable pieces.

props.text: React or Vue? You won't pick wrong.

beats.narration: Vue feels gentler. Its templates look like plain HTML, and its official tools guide you. Beginners often get something working fast, which keeps motivation high.
React asks you to write more JavaScript, and you choose more tools yourself. In return, it has a huge ecosystem and many job listings.
So want a job soon? Learn React. Want the smoothest start? Learn Vue. Either way, the skills transfer, so just start building today.

props.text: Jobs: React. Smooth start: Vue. Skills transfer.
